Episode 246: Battle for the Mithra Desert (1)
"Following Kinjelo, Zipul and the Jeokmyeong tribe have appeared in Raplarosa... And they've even brought three aerial fortresses?"
Jin narrowed his eyes as he spoke.
He had judged that the Jeokmyeong tribe would not fall for Kinjelo's trap. However, he never suspected that Zipul would leak the information about the 'King Tribe' to the Jeokmyeong tribe.
'Except for the Jeokmyeong tribe, other powers probably guessed that Raplarosa is in the Mithra Desert. I never thought they would lure us like this.'
Until now, Jin had intentionally shown no interest in Raplarosa.
He had not yet developed the technology to liberate the King Tribe, and other forces had not shown particular interest in the Mithra Desert either.

The Mithra Desert had been used as a chaotic waste disposal site since the Sword Emperor's War. Even if the enemies suspected the relationship between Raplarosa and the desert, there had been no problems arising from it.
After all, Raplarosa existed within the sub-space of Soldeuret. Even if the Mithra Desert was damaged, the hidden sub-space would not be destroyed.
But Eltiot warned that the situation could change if the Jeokmyeong tribe intervened.
"The red guys have the ability to track sub-space. Of course, they can't ignore the special conditions that exist for that Raplarosa sub-space, but they can somehow affect the sub-space itself."
"How, Master?"
"They could close the sub-space from the outside, or destroy it. Given enough time, they could even move the entire sub-space to another region."
If that happened, the liberation of Raplarosa would become forever impossible.
"We will secure the Mithra Desert starting now," Jin said in a calm voice.

"It's a little earlier than expected, but the Jeokmyeong tribe will soon surely know the exact location of Raplarosa. Since liberating Raplarosa has been our top priority since the moment we stole the vital part from Pivill, we must settle this now."
The analysis of Pivill's parts was already more than 90% complete. Kwaul was collaborating with Eltiot, who had somewhat regained his memory, to develop a Raplarosa summoning device.
"Commander Eltiot, when they track sub-space, is there equipment exposed to the outside?"
"It's not just separate equipment. It's all mounted on the aerial fortress."
"Then can we directly attack the aerial fortress and obtain the parts related to sub-space tracking?"
“What... It's not impossible. If we can break through the attacks of Shimat, the aerial fortresses, and the fleet.”
“If we obtain the parts for tracking the subspaces, will it help in our development of the device to summon Lafrarosa?”
“Of course, it's obvious. Tracking the subspaces is ultimately an application of wave tracking technology, so it will be even more helpful than the parts from Pivil that we've obtained.”
“Then it might actually be an opportunity. How long does it take for them to track the subspace?”
“It varies by the type of subspace. But in the case of Lafrarosa, since it was created by an immortal of the stature of a giant serpent in its heyday, it won't be over quickly.”

“Understood. The first sortie will be me, Luna, and Lieutenant Eltieot. Starting today, the three of us will head to the Mithra Desert to engage with them and gather information, supplementing our forces as needed later.”

Unlike the enemy tribe, the Bamel Alliance cannot invest many core personnel. They don't know when the enemy might suddenly invade the mainland, so the remaining personnel always need to be on standby. This was unavoidable until they narrowed the technology gap or liberated Lafrarosa.
Nevertheless, promising to supplement more personnel later meant that there will certainly be a moment when they must take the gamble, even if it entails the risk of invasion.
“Are you going right now, master?”

“Yes, Captain Kasimir. Ah, and please contact Yona. As Lieutenant Eltieot, Luna, and I draw attention, it would be good for Yona to gather information as well. Yona will enter an hour after we arrive.”
“Understood, master. Please take care.”
Kwa-Gwa-Gwang-! Chi-ing...!
In the center of the Mithra Desert, aerial fortresses relentlessly dropped their artillery. Kinzelo and Jipl were each dodging in different directions.
“These crazy, can't Jo and Bubar make something like that? What are those aerial fortresses? How can we fight properly against them?”
“If those stupid guys had such ability, we would have already succeeded.”

With fewer numbers, Kinzelo was relatively more comfortable enduring the shelling compared to Jipl. Belact, Badrei, Bianca, Shagal, Lanke. All five of them could fend off the aerial fortress’s artillery to some extent as long as it was not at maximum output.
“Damn, it seemed like this time my necromancy could succeed. Those damned bastards, if they were going to do this, they shouldn't have given us hope!”
“Don't feel too bad, General Lanke. It was sure to fail anyway.”
“Shut up! The enemy tribe also recognized the high value of my necromancy. That's why they're not destroying the equipment.”
“That's probably just their intention to figure out what we were doing. Once their analysis is done, they'll destroy it right away, so don't have vain regrets and hurt yourself further.”
“Lanke, hang...on.”
The Jikmyeong Tribe was forming an energy wave barrage to prevent Kinjello and Jiple from escaping the central desert.
Whenever an attempt was made to break through a point, concentrated bombardment poured down. Therefore, Kinjello and Jiple were only going around in circles within the barrage.
"Jin Lun Kandel, the man has arrived."
Shimart spoke as he looked over the battlefield's images from the Pivil's bridge.
No images reflecting Jin's party had appeared yet. Shimart was sensing Jin's party not with the detection ability of the airborne fortresses and fleet, but with his own senses.
"I will prepare a response."
"Have we located the sub-space?"
"Yes, although the exact location of the wave is still uncertain, the existence of the sub-space has been confirmed."
Shimart pondered for a moment, looking over the situation of the airborne fortresses Patl and Rital. The two fortresses were floating in place, with their sub-space tracking devices deployed.
"Then, immediately hide Patl and Rital's sub-space tracking devices. Cheongpungjae, that old man must have informed Jin Lun Kandel. So, they will try to secure our devices again this time."
Patl and Rital's sub-space tracking devices began to be retrieved. The devices resembled a net-like structure extending from the bottom of the airborne fortresses.

"Rital, get out right now and strike Tikangung. Skilled ones including Murakan will be waiting, so just safely suppress them with long-range bombardment. The goal is disruption, not annihilation. Then, once they start sending out their forces in earnest, return to the Mithra Desert."
"Understood."

"Pivil and Patl, from now on, fix the main gun's power to 30% and block the approach of Baekgyeong and Eltiyet. Then, when I face Jin Lun Kandel in direct sword combat, dynamically increase the main gun's power and target the weakest among Jin Lun Kandel, Baekgyeong, and Eltiyet."
The bridge was opened.
Unlike last time, there was no intention of being absurdly robbed of parts by the Barmel Alliance. Shimart was planning to drag the upcoming battle in the Mithra Desert into a long-term struggle.

Still, he had no intention of engaging in a full-fledged battle with the Barmel Alliance. If he could simply block the Alliance from achieving anything in the Mithra Desert, it would eliminate the biggest variable in the Jikmyeong Tribe's path to supremacy.

Of course, they would try to proceed with the sub-space tracking as much as possible when the Barmel Alliance's strong players were not in the Mithra Desert, so that would delay the destruction of Lafrarosa. But it was a much better plan than rushing in and messing things up.
Soon, Shimart leaped out of the bridge. He shot his sword energy toward the direction where Jin's party was approaching without even glancing at Kinjelo and Jipil's nearby groups.
And Jin, even before the sword energy entered his sight, displayed a meteor shower to intercept it. A giant red sword energy clashed with the meteors in the middle of the desert.
"Sister and Eltiot, focus on securing the device. I will hold Shimart."
"Understood, little one. Be careful! Shimart, supported by the airborne fortress, showed an invincibility I couldn't even see."

"That guy has no romance as a warrior; he's the type who thinks winning is all that matters. So if you feel it's dangerous, get out right away. At least he doesn't seem to have brought Cree, the reconnaissance-only airborne fortress, which is a relief."
The three dispersed. Jin headed toward Shimart alone, and Eltiot and Luna went together to find the space-tracking device.
Jin and Shimart's distance was closing. Jin immediately noticed that only two airborne fortresses were left.
'Where did the other one go?'
He couldn't find out through communication because of the enemy's wave.

'The most likely possibility is that it was sent to attack our base. Shimart personally led a force of that size, and since Kinjelo and Jipil's people haven't been properly dealt with, there's no reason to send it to them now. But with one, neither Tican nor the Garden of Swords can be breached, so maybe it's just for disruption.'
He's planning to drag this into a protracted battle.

Jin thought so and infused his energy into Sigmund. A long battle would be disadvantageous to the Bamel Alliance in many ways. They were already losing control, and this would tip the balance completely.
'First, I'll have to figure out if there are any factors that could become variables during the battle. The most hopeful thing is Yona, my sister's information gathering.'
Soon, Jin and Shimart clashed.
"Jin Lun Candel, you look very worried. You seem to fear that the reunion with your brothers might go awry."

"I was surprised to hear you were a fighting god, Shimart. From the time you acted like a first-class warrior, you seemed to be one of the smarter ones among the Red Allied Tribes, but you've become quite a nuisance."
Sigmund and Tetallon collided, and a shockwave erupted. Blue and red energy intertwined, each jabbing into the other's flesh.
The place where they clashed was about seven hundred steps away from where Lanke's necromancy equipment was located.
And both of them felt it at the same moment as the first shockwave spread – magic suddenly began to surge from the desert on the other side.
Lanke's necromancy equipment absorbed the shockwaves they created like a mouth.
